unmappedReports: Everything. This device has no local protocol, so nothing it measures reaches a MetricKind by any local path. The list below is what it does measure, recorded so the gap is visible rather than silently dropped., Digital inputs ×2, which are also pulse counters — 'you can view their current state and the number of detected pulses (rising edge, 1000Hz max) in VRM'. switch-state is boolean and there is no pulse-count MetricKind., Relay position — switch-state and set-switch both exist in the contract, but the relay is only operable from VRM's device list page with up to 15 min of queueing latency, so neither can be claimed., Cellular signal strength, operator name and number, SIM status, LTE connection status, and which antenna is selected (internal vs external switch) — visible in VRM and on the VictronConnect status screen, with no local read path. link-signal-quality and link-online have no source here., Count of connected Bluetooth smart devices — no MetricKind., Input voltage on its own power connector — the vendor calls this 'not very accurate' (±0.2 V at 14 V, ±0.5 V at 24 V, ±1 V at 48 V) and uses it in VRM only as a fallback when no attached device can measure voltage. battery-voltage would be a lie: it is the GlobalLink's own supply rail., For every attached product the uploaded attribute set is dominated by 'state', 'mode', 'off reason', 'error code', 'alarm reason', 'warning reason'. The contract has no MetricKind for a fault or off-reason code; ChargeStage cannot carry it., 'Active AC input' (VE.Bus Smart Dongle, Multi RS) — no MetricKind, same gap already recorded for the GX at register 826., Per-cell voltages (Lithium Battery Smart, cells 1–8) and balancer status — no MetricKind., Aux voltage (BMV/SmartShunt) — no MetricKind.
